name: A month of books of a Nairobi trading company, VAT-registered and filing monthly

documents.why: A domestic sale at the standard rate of 16 %: box 1 and the output VAT of box 6.
A money-transfer agency commission, exempt under paragraph 1(b) of Part II of the First Schedule: box 4, no output VAT, and a matched payment later on.
An export of goods, zero-rated under paragraph 1 of Part A of the Second Schedule: box 3, no output VAT, and a matched payment later on.
An export of a service to a customer with no place of business in Kenya, zero-rated under paragraph 23 of Part A of the Second Schedule: box 3.
A domestic sale of a good the Second Schedule zero-rates without it leaving Kenya, so a zero rate is proven that is neither a domestic reverse charge nor an export: box 3.

lines.name: Liquefied petroleum gas cylinders, retail sale

documents.why: A credit note for one unit returned from INV-001, so box 1 and box 6 fall back down and a sale_credit_note is exercised.

lines.name: Office furniture, retail sale — one unit returned

documents.why: A domestic purchase at the standard rate, deductible in full: box 7 and the input VAT of box 12, and a matched payment later on.
A passenger car whose input tax is disallowed under section 17(4)(a): the VAT becomes part of the cost of the vehicle and reaches no box.

lines.name: Passenger motor vehicle for the sales manager

documents.why: A purchase of a zero-rated good from a registered supplier: no input tax, reported in box 9.
An insurance premium, exempt under paragraph 2 of Part II of the First Schedule: no input tax, box 10.
An import of goods: VAT collected by KRA at the border under section 22, claimed as input tax through box 7 and box 12, and held on the customs control account until settled.

A service imported from a supplier with no place of business in Kenya: the recipient self-charges the output tax under section 10 and claims it back through box 15, netting to nothing on a wholly taxable purchase.
A purchase credit note for a short delivery on PINV-001, so box 7 and box 12 fall back down and a purchase_credit_note is exercised.

lines.name: Trading stock purchased for resale — short-delivery credit

payments.why: The agency commission of INV-002 collected in full: a matched inbound payment on an exempt sale.
The export of INV-003 collected in full: a matched inbound payment in a foreign trade relationship.
PINV-001 settled in full, VAT included: a matched outbound payment.
An advance received from Chalmers Consulting Ltd before its next invoice, matched to nothing: reconcile() has to survive an open item.
